title: NSF Gulfstream V surveys over the triangle
summary: Breaks Silence tells of NSF Gulfstream V surveys over the triangle, about recent at the triangle, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when you've got the National Science Foundation's $50 million Gulfstream 5 jet

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah famous for reports of strange happenings, says that a part of the ranch called the triangle has been surveyed from the air. He says the plane was the National Science Foundation's 50 million dollar Gulfstream V jet, the NSF being a US government agency that funds science. He tells it as proof that serious scientific resources are being pointed at the ranch's mysteries.
